editorial.blurb: A Michelin Bib Gourmand–recognized Italian spot where house-made pastas and imported ingredients shine, especially the pizzas and fresh burrata.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pizza over the pasta—the Bufalina and Pizza Diavola are standouts. Ask your server (like Ellie) for specials, though note that some advertised items may be unavailable that evening.
